sections.risk_rationale: Guideline requires purely descriptive historical arc (early comet preference, shift after D/H mismatches, asteroid arguments, quote from Ashley King) supported by Rosetta and enstatite sources with no normative leaps or thin analogies.

Section quantitatively contrasts Giotto/Rosetta/Winchcombe/Ryugu D/H data per guideline but pivots to 'radical alternative' of endogenous production by highlighting noble-gas/xenon mismatches whose interpretive weight exceeds direct source coverage.

Core mechanism and diamond-anvil results are directly from the two Nature golden sources, but guideline-mandated broad habitability conclusion ('expanding the number of potentially habitable worlds') extrapolates to exoplanet implications with applicability-debate quotes only partially covered.

Guideline explicitly requires synthesis of mixed-source model plus cross-domain analogy to origin-of-life ('richer network of possible pathways') that is only tangentially supported by the noble-gas, Rosetta reanalysis, and enstatite sources.

parsed.overall_notes: No section contains invented narratives or pre-scripted fictional examples; all are evidence-driven interpretations of distinct primary studies (two Nature papers plus mission/meteorite analyses). Moderate-to-high argumentative risk is concentrated in S3/S4 due to habitability extrapolations and origin-of-life parallel, on a topic that mixes canonical comet/asteroid debate with emerging endogenous models.
